title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 115 (Mount Judge Howay Park)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Mount Judge Howay Park
115 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in M.U. 2-8 that is within the Mount Judge Howay Park boundaries. [en. B.C. Reg. 204/91, s. 12.]
